elements.text: Component quality with a fixed midpoint

Grade III retains the normal physical baseline.

Relative performance and power ratios become smooth I–V curves.

Weapon-specific profiles can override the generic component curve.

A refit still has to pass the SSW reactor budget.

exponent = (grade - 3) / 4.0
performance = reference_performance_ratio ** exponent
power_demand = reference_power_ratio ** exponent

# At grade III, exponent = 0 → both multipliers = 1
# Formula summary; actual profiles remain in SSW JSON.
